item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:35 HKT 11/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to southern China today and tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. Under the influence of replenishments of the monsoon and a band of clouds, it will be cloudier with rather cool mornings over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. An intense northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong in the latter part of this week. The weather will improve and become cold over the region. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the seas east of the Philippines will move in the generally direction of the seas south of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days.
